title: Research Snacks: data, code and methods
description:
Shareable inputs, code, methods and expected tables behind Research Snacks, short public checks of claims against primary data. Each snack can be rerun with uv run check.py.

Code is MIT; our text, annotations and derived data are CC BY 4.0; third-party data keep their own terms (see LICENCE.md and DATA-SOURCES.md in the archive). No IPUMS microdata or corpus text is included.
